# The way back after a wait timeout. The review wait ends as a failed run. A second beehave run is refused. beehave resume reopens the run, and beehave run then continues it
# at the review with the plan and the finished sections kept: the planner does not run again.
[!exec:jq] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

rdinit
rdfakes
env HOME=$WORK/home
env RESEARCH_DESK_DIR=$WORK/rd
env RESEARCH_HOME=$WORK/store
env SEARCH_API=http://search.test
env WIKI_API=http://wiki.test
env RESEARCH_HEADER_FILE=$WORK/home/.research/credential.header
env MAX_AGENT_CALLS=40
env REVIEW_TIMEOUT=2s

exec beehavereal item add research-desk warm-cost --title 'Warm and cost' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run warm-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr 'REFUSE: no answer to the review of the draft within 2s'
grep -count=1 '^plan$' calls.log

# A second run of the failed item is refused.
env REVIEW_TIMEOUT=72h
! exec beehavereal run warm-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star
stderr .

# The documented way back: resume reopens the failed run, then run continues it.
exec beehavereal resume warm-cost
exec beehavereal run warm-cost research-desk --workflow rd/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'paused: Review the draft report of warm-cost, round 1'
exec beehavereal answer warm-cost approve
wait
stdout 'item warm-cost finished'
grep -count=1 '^warm-cost-' wiki.log
grep -count=1 '^plan$' calls.log

-- body.txt --
How does the cold change the output of a unit, and what does it cost?
-- home/.research/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_search --
{"results":[{"url":"http://pages.test/page/a"},{"url":"http://pages.test/page/b"}]}
-- resp/_page_a --
<p>Winter tests. At -20 C the output fell by 30 percent.</p>
-- resp/_page_b --
<p>The unit costs 12 euro per month.</p>
